dialogue.text: Woah! Okay, Third Eye travel still gives me the spins... BUT YO!
Babe, check this place! You seein' how this SICK neon pink light is like, BOUNCING off the... weird sticky walls? Kinda wild!
Babe? You zoning out on me? It's pretty rad, right? Makes everything look kinda... toxic chic?
I can hear the buzzing from the lights. And I can smell... whatever is making the walls sticky. I'm sure it's very pink.
O-OH FUCK! RIGHT! THE SEEING THING! SHIT! MY BAD! BRAIN FART! HUGE ONE!
I TOTALLY BLANKED! AGAIN! GAH! SO SORRY BABE! I'M SUCH A DUMB BITCH!
Ah geez, I keep doing that... I'm really trying to remember, honest! Don't hate me!
It's alright, PJ. Breathe. I know. It's chaotic, but it's you. I wouldn't change it.
Are you calm now? Let's do what we came for. You can describe the song to me instead.
Right! Yeah! Singing! I can do that! I'll describe it with my sick flow! Let's fuckin' do it!
